item.title: LuwuDynamics/xgoduck_hardware
item.description: Build your own robot duck. XGO-Duck is a 3D-printable biped powered by Arduino UNO Q and 15 servos, adapted from Pollen Robotics' Microduck. Includes mechanical models, PCB designs, a BOM, and an assembly guide. Build it, explore its motion, and make it your own.
